scientific_contract: Seven heterogeneous sources create exact curated relations without inventing GO evidence
Identity and coverage are inclusive; bit score and e-value are exclusive
Process-tree CPU and RSS aggregation is exact and environment-independent
OrthoFinder group IDs, species and sequences remain exact through integration
Pocket residues, mapping fractions and pLDDT denominators use exact structure evidence
Global and local structural decisions retain exact residue mappings and thresholds
Atlas five-number summary uses the median and retains all five values
Every gN context uses configuration-XML assay membership and one metadata row
TPM is preferred and FPKM is fallback only
Expression threshold is inclusive at 0.5 and contexts retain tissues
Domain fractions include only assessed configured target species
Displayed group counts are group-level and thresholds/glossary match recorded rules
Glossary, denominator help and threshold controls match workflow rules
